Existing single missing-task regression also passes. Actual Mac local file bytes verified; iOS native sharing cancellation.

General production UI account chooser, hosted freshness/multiwriter, I/O-phase account/session races, broad series/spoken/large-workload and release acceptance remain open.

contract: Mutation.orderRecovery is optional Codable v1 device-local evidence. It binds command UUID, account/backend, complete before/after preference rows and task generation/project identities. It is separate from change.fields; no metadata enters HTTP row writes. Unsupported captures retain original write behavior; old queues are not assigned fabricated history. Whole same-row vectors/histories are preserved rather than split. Other rows and independent task edits remain untouched. Missing unrelated rows are retained as explicit unavailable references with no inferred generation/project. Such a reference cannot authorize a recreated affected task.
